summary: Studio City International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K enclosing quarterly reports of Studio City Finance and Studio City Investments. The explanatory note reveals that Studio City Company, a subsidiary, conducted a conditional tender offer in May 2026 for its 2027 SCC Senior Secured Notes, purchasing US$196.421 million aggregate principal of the outstanding US$350 million 7.00% notes. Terms are cash consideration at an undisclosed price; no premium stated. The notes are senior secured. The offer reduces the issuer's debt overhang. The next watch item is any resulting gain/loss on extinguishment and potential further debt management steps.
